attack_surface.registration_seam: server.ts::addToolWithAudit runs policyFor for every tool; 130-row TOOL_ACCESS_POLICY (1 enforce, 31 in-tool, 53 baselined, 45 none)

appendix.title: Backend REST routes are owner-equivalent for an agent-scoped key; 53 MCP tools carry a `baselined` policy row for the same reason
appendix.where: src/backend/dependencies.py (get_current_user resolves an agent key to its owner carrying the owner's role — Invariant #8); src/mcp-server/src/access.ts TOOL_ACCESS_POLICY rows marked `baselined` (36 → abilityai/trinity-enterprise#629, 11 admin/human-only at the backend, 3 reminders self-gate, 3 connector-scope)
appendix.exploit: Agent A (or anyone who can exec into its container) uses its injected TRINITY_MCP_API_KEY raw against POST /api/agents/{B}/loops, or through any `baselined` tool — including delete_agent, start_agent, stop_agent, set_agent_github_pat, export_agent_data, call_user, get_agent_auth — on a same-owner sibling B with no agent_permissions edge.
appendix.impact: Same-owner blast radius; the MCP tool-surface gate closed by this PR does not hold one hop down.
appendix.note: Not introduced by this diff. The diff makes the exposure explicit and enumerable (the table) and routes it to abilityai/trinity-enterprise#629 by operator decision (2026-09-15 plan gate); the destructive subset is named there as the reason to raise priority. A communicate edge is not a manage permission, so the rows are a ruling, not a row flip.

appendix.title: A returned denial is audited as a successful tool call; the loop-id tools' rows carry no target
appendix.where: src/mcp-server/src/audit.ts:169-178 (success = no throw), :56-69 (resolveTargetId reads agent_name|agent|name only)
appendix.exploit: An operator reading the SEC-001 audit log cannot see that agent A was refused a loop, status read or stop on B; for the loop-id pair the row has no target_id at all.
appendix.impact: Audit blind spot on refusals (the compensating control reviewers assume exists).
appendix.note: Class tracked as abilityai/trinity#2807 (J10 strict xfail). This diff adds get_loop_status/stop_loop to the class and states so on ent#628; the fix belongs to #2807 for every gate at once.

appendix.title: The `none` shape check does not treat `name` as an agent-target parameter
appendix.where: src/mcp-server/src/access.ts AGENT_TARGET_PARAMS (agent_name|agent|target_agent|source_agent) and the comment explaining why `name` is excluded
appendix.exploit: A future agents.ts tool keyed on `name` and mistakenly given a `none:` row would pass the shape check. It still cannot register without a human-written row, and the row must state a `why`.
appendix.impact: Residual human-error window on one module's naming convention; no live tool affected (all `name`-keyed agent tools carry explicit baselined/in-tool rows).
appendix.note: Not a vulnerability introduced by the diff; recorded so the limitation is not mistaken for coverage.
